title: Danqing Craft

outfit_card.silhouette: Layered Chinese-inspired ensemble with a sheer white duster coat over a high-collared jade bodice, asymmetrical layered skirt with a high-low hem, and slim column silhouette softened by flowing robe panels and wide sleeves.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Jade-tipped hairpin with a blue tassel and a small floral branch ornament, plus a thin metallic headband accent.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: High-collared jade silk bodice with gold filigree embroidery, layered under a white sheer organza duster coat with wide bell sleeves and gold trim at cuffs, featuring a central dragon motif in gold thread.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Asymmetrical layered skirt in translucent green and white organza with gold embroidered hem, over a short inner layer, paired with patterned sheer stockings and dark teal heeled boots with gold accents.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating ink-wash brushstroke motifs and a small jade pendant with a blue tassel hanging from the waist sash.
